inception-2010.editorial: Inception is Nolan's most rewatchable film — each viewing reveals a new layer you missed before. If you enjoy films that challenge your perception of reality, this is essential watching.

the-dark-knight-2008.editorial: A gritty, realistic take on Batman that redefined the superhero genre. Heath Ledger's Joker is legendary.

interstellar-2014.editorial: A visually stunning sci-fi epic exploring love and time dilation. The score by Hans Zimmer is unforgettable.

dunkirk-2017.editorial: A tense, visceral war film told from three distinct perspectives with minimal dialogue. A masterclass in suspense.

tenet-2020.editorial: An ambitious action thriller with a complex time-inversion concept. Visually spectacular but requires strict attention.
